for day in rain:
    if day == 0:
        dry = dry + 1
print("Dry days:", dry)
print("Total:", sum(rain))

FUNCTION search(items, target)
    low <- 0
    high <- LEN(items) - 1
    WHILE low <= high
        mid <- (low + high) DIV 2
        IF items[mid] = target THEN
            RETURN mid
        ELSE IF items[mid] < target THEN
            high <- mid - 1
        ELSE
            low <- mid + 1
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
    RETURN -1
ENDFUNCTION
